# Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 — iOS Decompilation & Native PC Port

**Complete clean-room decompilation of the 2011 iOS release of *Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3* (v1.2.59) — all 2,572 game functions transcribed to C and verified — with a native PC port for Windows, Linux, and macOS.**

[Getting Started](https://github.com/MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Decompiled/blob/HEAD/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md) · [How the Game Works](https://github.com/MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Decompiled/blob/HEAD/docs/HOW-THE-GAME-WORKS.md) · [Architecture](https://github.com/MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Decompiled/blob/HEAD/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Progress](https://github.com/MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Decompiled/blob/HEAD/docs/PROGRESS.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Decompiled/blob/HEAD/docs/CHANGELOG.md) · [Español](https://github.com/MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Decompiled/blob/HEAD/README.es.md)
